info.title: Partner Merchant Rates API
info.description:
Create or update **TDR/TSF pricing** for a merchant (**MID**) that your partner account referred.
Rates are stored per payment mechanism, instrument, optional card type, and optional transaction amount slab.

## Prerequisites

All of the following must be satisfied before calling this API:

1. Valid OAuth access token in the `Authorization` header (`Bearer` prefix required).
2. Partner (`reseller_uuid`) must exist and be a **platform partner** (`is_platform_partner = true`).
3. Token must include scope **`refer_merchant`**.
4. Token user must be authorized as **owner** of the partner (standard partner portal token).
5. `mid` must be an existing merchant product-account identifier **linked to your partner** (merchant referred by you).
6. Use only `payment_mechanism` and `instrument` codes that exist in PayU's catalog. Invalid codes fail at the **pricing entry** level.

> **Discover standard partner rate cards (optional):**
> `GET /api/v1/partners/fetch_rates?reseller_uuid={reseller_uuid}&business_category_id={id}` — use the same auth.
> Merchant Rates API sets **merchant-specific** overrides on top of partner defaults.

## Business Logic

### Upsert (create or update)
- First call for a MID creates a **product account plan** and rate rows.
- Subsequent calls with the same `payment_mechanism` + `instrument` + `card_type` (+ same `amount_slab` if used) **update** existing rates.
- Per-entry success messages: `"Rate created"` or `"Rate updated"`.

### Amount Slabs

| `amount_slab` | Where rates are stored |
|---|---|
| **Not sent** | `PlanDetail` (`tdr_percentage` → `rate`, `tdr_flat` → `flat_charge`, etc.) |
| **Sent** | `GmvBucket` for that slab; `PlanDetail` holds structure, slab holds the actual %/flat values |

- Different slabs (e.g. `0–2000` and `2001–5000`) create **separate** buckets for the same instrument.
- `amount_slab: { "min_amount": 0 }` only → open-ended slab from 0 upward (`max_amount` = null).

### TSF Rules
TSF (`tsf_percentage` / `tsf_flat`) is allowed only when:
- `payment_mechanism` is **`UPI`**, **or**
- `instrument` starts with **`RUPAY`** (e.g. `RUPAYCC`).

TSF is rejected if **either** `tsf_percentage > 0` **or** `tsf_flat > 0` on other instruments (e.g. AMEX, regular CC).
`0` / omitted TSF is always fine on any instrument.

### Card Type Mapping (CC / DC only)

| You send | Stored as |
|---|---|
| `Domestic`, `domestic`, `unknown`, `not_present` | `default` |
| `International`, `international` | `international` |
| `Corporate`, `corporate` | `corporate` |
| `Prepaid`, `prepaid` | `prepaid` |

Unrecognized values default to `default`.

### Batch Processing
- Entries are processed **in array order**; index `0` is first.
- One bad entry does **not** roll back successful siblings.
- Max **300** entries per request.

## Integration Checklist

1. Obtain token with `refer_merchant` scope for a **platform** partner.
2. Refer merchant and note **`mid`** (product account identifier).
3. `POST` with 1+ valid `pricing` entries; `tdr_percentage` is required on every entry.
4. For **CC/DC**, always send `card_type`.
5. Use **TSF** only on **UPI** or **RUPAY*** instruments.
6. On **200** + `partial_success`, fix failed `results[i]` and resubmit **only** corrected entries (or full batch if easier).
7. On **422** + service `message`, fix the request-level issue (MID, link, batch size) before retrying.

tags.name: Merchant Rates
tags.description: Set TDR/TSF pricing for merchants referred by your partner account

post.description:
Create or update TDR/TSF pricing for a merchant referred by your partner account.

Supports batch upsert of up to **300** pricing entries per request. Each entry is processed independently — a failure on one entry does not roll back others.

**Response shape depends on outcome:**
- HTTP **200** + `status: success` → all entries processed successfully.
- HTTP **200** + `status: partial_success` → some entries succeeded, some failed. Always inspect `results[]`.
- HTTP **422** + `status: error` (with `results`) → all entries failed.
- HTTP **422** + `status: error` (with `message`, no `results`) → service-level failure (bad MID, not linked, batch > 300).
- HTTP **400 / 401 / 403 / 404** → request rejected before entry processing.

simple_rates.description: Rates stored on PlanDetail. UPI allows TSF; CC requires card_type.

with_amount_slabs.description: Entry 0 creates a 0–2000 GmvBucket. Entry 1 is open-ended (max_amount null). Second call with same keys → "Rate updated".

international_rupay.description: TSF allowed because instrument starts with RUPAY. card_type International stored as "international".

minimal_upi.description: Smallest valid payload. Only tdr_percentage is required besides mechanism and instrument.

partial_success_mix.description: Entry 0 is valid UPI; entries 1 and 2 use invalid codes to demonstrate partial_success.

200.description:
Request processed. Check `status` field:
- `success` — all entries succeeded (`failed` = 0).
- `partial_success` — some entries failed. Inspect `results[]` and retry failed indices.

> **Do not rely on HTTP status alone.** HTTP 200 can contain failed rows when `status` is `partial_success`.

rate_updated.summary: Rate updated (second call with same keys)

400.description: Missing or invalid required top-level fields. Returned before auth or entry processing.

invalid_pricing.summary: pricing missing, empty, or not an array

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired Bearer token.

403.description:
One of:
- Partner is not a platform partner (`is_platform_partner = false`).
- Token lacks `refer_merchant` scope.
- Token user is not the partner owner.

> Returns the same JSON body as 401 — distinguish by **HTTP status code**.

404.description:
`reseller_uuid` not found **or** omitted/null in the request body.

> Note: A missing `reseller_uuid` returns 404, not 400.

422.description:
Three possible shapes:

| Shape | `processed` / `failed` / `results` present? | When |
|---|---|---|
| `{ "status": "error", "message": "..." }` | No | Service-level failure — MID not found, not linked, batch > 300, server misconfiguration |
| `{ "status": "error", "processed": 0, "failed": N, "results": [...] }` | Yes | All pricing entries failed |
| `{ "error": "..." }` | No | Unhandled exception |

**Service-level `message` values (exact):**
- `Partner not found`
- `Merchant MID not found`
- `Merchant MID is not linked to this partner`
- `Maximum 300 pricing entries allowed per request`
- `Default payment mode 'Others' not found` *(server misconfiguration)*
- `Default payment gateway 'Default' not found` *(server misconfiguration)*

mid_not_linked.summary: MID not linked to this partner

value.message: Merchant MID is not linked to this partner
Maximum 300 pricing entries allowed per request

bearerAuth.description:
OAuth access token for a **platform partner** with `refer_merchant` scope.

Format: `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`

reseller_uuid.description: Your partner UUID. Must belong to a platform partner.

mid.description: Merchant product-account identifier. Must be referred by your partner.

pricing.description:
Array of 1–300 rate entries. Must be a JSON **array** (not an object or string).
Entries are processed in order; index `0` is first.

payment_mechanism.description:
Short code matching `OnePayuPaymentMode.title`. Case-sensitive.

Common values: `UPI`, `CC`, `DC`.
Exact codes depend on PayU environment configuration.

instrument.description:
`OnePayuPaymentOption.identifier`. Must belong to the given `payment_mechanism`.

Examples by mechanism:
- `UPI` → `UPI`
- `CC` → `CC`, `RUPAYCC`, `AMEX`
- `DC` → `DC`, `VISA`, `RUPAYDC`

tdr_flat.description: Flat TDR charge in currency units. Optional; if sent, must be ≥ 0.

tsf_percentage.description:
TSF percentage. Optional.

If value > 0, only allowed when `payment_mechanism` is `UPI` **or** `instrument` starts with `RUPAY` (e.g. `RUPAYCC`).
Sending `0` or omitting is always valid on any instrument.

tsf_flat.description:
Flat TSF charge. Optional.

Same instrument restrictions as `tsf_percentage` when value > 0.

card_type.description:
**Required when `payment_mechanism` is `CC` or `DC`.** Case-insensitive.

| Input | Stored as |
|---|---|
| `Domestic`, `domestic`, `unknown`, `not_present` | `default` |
| `International`, `international` | `international` |
| `Corporate`, `corporate` | `corporate` |
| `Prepaid`, `prepaid` | `prepaid` |

Unrecognized values default to `default`.

AmountSlab.description:
Optional transaction amount range for this pricing entry.

| Provided? | Storage |
|---|---|
| **Omitted** | Rates apply on `PlanDetail` (flat rate for that instrument) |
| **Present** | Rates apply only for transactions in that range via `GmvBucket` |

Different slabs for the same instrument create separate buckets. A second call with the same slab bounds **updates** the existing bucket.

min_amount.description: Lower bound (inclusive). Defaults to `0` if omitted. Must be ≥ 0.

max_amount.description:
Upper bound (inclusive). May be omitted for an open-ended slab (`end_range = null`).
Must be > `min_amount` when both are provided.

BatchResponse.description:
Returned when auth and top-level validation pass and the service runs entry processing.
Present on HTTP **200** (`success` / `partial_success`) and HTTP **422** (`error` when all entries fail).

status.description:
| Value | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `success` | 200 | All entries succeeded; `failed` = 0 |
| `partial_success` | 200 | Some succeeded, some failed. Retry only failed indices. |
| `error` | 422 | All entries failed; `processed` = 0 |

processed.description: Number of successfully processed pricing entries.

results.description: Per-entry outcome, in the same order as the request `pricing` array.

index.description: Zero-based index of this entry in the request `pricing` array.

message.description:
**Success messages:**
- `Rate created` — new rate row or slab created.
- `Rate updated` — existing rate row or slab updated.

**Error messages (exact strings):**

| Message | Condition |
|---|---|
| `tdr_percentage is mandatory` | Field missing or null |
| `tdr_percentage must be a valid number` | Non-numeric string provided |
| `tdr_percentage must be >= 0` | Negative value |
| `tsf_percentage must be a valid number` | Provided but non-numeric |
| `tsf_percentage must be >= 0` | Negative value |
| `tdr_flat must be a valid number` | Provided but non-numeric |
| `tdr_flat must be >= 0` | Negative value |
| `tsf_flat must be a valid number` | Provided but non-numeric |
| `tsf_flat must be >= 0` | Negative value |
| `amount_slab.min_amount must be a valid number` | Invalid `min_amount` |
| `amount_slab.min_amount must be >= 0` | Negative `min_amount` |
| `amount_slab.max_amount must be a valid number` | Invalid `max_amount` |
| `amount_slab.max_amount must be >= 0` | Negative `max_amount` |
| `amount_slab.min_amount must be less than amount_slab.max_amount` | `min_amount` ≥ `max_amount` |
| `card_type is mandatory for payment_mechanism CC or DC` | CC/DC without `card_type` |
| `TSF is only allowed for UPI or Rupay instruments` | TSF > 0 on non-UPI, non-Rupay instrument |
| `Invalid payment_mechanism '<CODE>'` | Unknown mechanism code (dynamic) |
| `Invalid instrument '<INSTR>' for payment_mechanism '<MECH>'` | Unknown instrument or wrong mode (dynamic) |

ServiceError.description:
Service-level fatal error. The request never processes pricing entries (or processing aborts before per-entry results).
No `processed` / `failed` / `results` fields present.

message.description:
**Exact message values:**

| Message | When |
|---|---|
| `Partner not found` | Internal consistency (normally blocked by 404 on bad UUID) |
| `Merchant MID not found` | `mid` does not exist |
| `Merchant MID is not linked to this partner` | MID exists but belongs to another partner |
| `Maximum 300 pricing entries allowed per request` | `pricing.length` > 300 |
| `Default payment mode 'Others' not found` | Server misconfiguration |
| `Default payment gateway 'Default' not found` | Server misconfiguration |

StatusResponse.description: Returned for auth and partner-lookup failures (401, 403, 404).

ErrorMessage.description: Returned for controller validation failures (400) and unhandled exceptions (422).
